title: WRCC2023_MI_A: WRCC2023 MI-A three-class motor imagery dataset
description: A three-class motor imagery EEG dataset (left hand, right hand, feet) from the MI-A track of the 2023 World Robot Contest BCI competition. It includes recordings from nine participants, two of whom are stroke patients, with 90 cued 4-second imagery trials each (30 per class). Data were acquired at 1000 Hz from 59 EEG channels using a Neuracle wireless system and re-released in BIDS format with HED annotations via MOABB.
methods_description: Cue-based offline motor imagery paradigm with left-hand grasping, right-hand grasping and foot hooking imagery. Each subject performed 90 trials (30 per class), stored as 4 s epochs. EEG was recorded with a Neuracle 64-channel wireless amplifier (59 EEG channels, 10-10 montage) at 1000 Hz, with 50 Hz line frequency.
